decisions.reason: Accepting HubSpot default reports does not change the creation or management of HubSpot lead lists.
The reporting simplification does not remove or modify the custom properties, tags, stages, or categories used to classify leads.
The source decision concerns report format and does not change the HubSpot task-assignment system.
Using default reports does not affect visibility of email or LinkedIn chat history in lead records.
The source decision does not alter the requirement to include lead notes in HubSpot.
Acceptance of default reporting does not change the lead-nurturing workflows or their scope.
The reporting decision does not change how MeetAlfred activity maps to HubSpot Lead Status values.
The choice to use HubSpot default reports does not affect synchronization of HubSpot lists or contacts to MeetAlfred.
The reporting change does not alter the LinkedIn-to-Apollo-to-HubSpot transfer path or its behavior.
The source decision does not change Apollo enrichment of HubSpot contact data.
Using default HubSpot reports does not affect which LinkedIn-related URLs are stored in CRM records.
The client accepts a reporting mode but does not change the general requirement to configure HubSpot CRM.
